_gemini_flash_note: gemini_flash MUST track whatever the `flash` tier resolves to in agy-delegate.sh's model_for_tier(), because agy-cost-compare.sh picks this key by tier NAME, not by model. Today that is Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), so gemini_flash mirrors gemini_flash_38 (3.8, 3.7 and 3.6 carry identical list prices). IMPORTANT: 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 are on PROMOTIONAL pricing that ends 2026-12-31 — on 2027-01-01 input goes 0.75 -> 1.50, output 3.75 -> 7.50 and cached_in 0.075 -> 0.15. Leaving these as-is after that date understates the Gemini side by half. The _post_2026 entries carry the standard rates; copy them over then. Verified 2026-09-03 against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and Google Cloud's Agent Platform pricing page (cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/generative-ai/pricing; non-global endpoints are +10%).
_comment: Per-1M-token USD: Gemini on Vertex AI ~2026-07 (global endpoints; regional/multi-region carry a ~10% premium), Kimi k3 from the official platform rates 2026-09. VERIFY against current Google Cloud / platform.kimi.ai pricing before quoting.
_cache_note: cache_write_mult / cache_read_mult apply to the orchestrator deck (default kimi_k3): cache_write_mult 1.0 reproduces the published $3.00/M cache-write rate (equal to input; verified at https://platform.kimi.ai/ on 2026-09-23), and cache_read_mult 0.1 reproduces kimi_k3's published cached_in exactly (3.00 x 0.1 = 0.30). Gemini prices cached input at a flat rate (cached_in) and bills context-cache STORAGE by time, which agy does not report — so any Gemini-side figure you compute here is a LOWER BOUND.
_kimi_k3_note: kimi_k3 is the ORCHESTRATOR deck (the model Kimi Code runs). Rates are the official platform.kimi.ai per-token prices, September 2026: $3.00/M input, $15.00/M output, $3.00/M cache writes, $0.30/M cached input. IMPORTANT: Kimi Code SUBSCRIPTIONS are quota-based (a plan, not per-token billing), so these rates apply only when running through the paid platform API — for a subscription the deck is a model-agnostic $-proxy for comparing token volumes, not a bill. Replaces the Claude decks of the original Claude Code plugin (claude_opus 5/25, claude_sonnet 3/15, removed in the Kimi fork).
